name: Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc.
old_description: At Pajaro Valley Fabrication, we understand the unique challenges in fabricating one-off or large-scale production items alike.
about:
Pajaro Valley Fabrication Inc. operates from a 10,000-square-foot facility in Watsonville, California. The company was founded in 2006 and is privately held; ownership details are not publicly disclosed. It began as a custom metal fabrication shop serving local agricultural and industrial needs.

The shop provides custom metal fabrication, welding (MIG, Stick, Flux Core, TIG), waterjet cutting via a Flow Mach 2 machine with a 10-by-6-foot bed, bending and shearing using two Amada hydraulic shears and two hydraulic presses, rolling, machining (drilling, lathe, hole punching), design, assembly, and material sales with cutting, cleaning, and punching services. Four-plus full-time fabricators handle one-off prototypes through large production runs.

Agriculture accounts for roughly 65 percent of the business, with the company supplying prototype components, maintenance parts, and structural repairs for farm equipment, including hydraulic system work. Commercial and residential clients receive products such as custom ventilation tubes, truck beds with power lifts, trailers, lumber racks, sandblasting tubes, barbecue tables, fire pits, gates, and stainless countertops.

The company emphasizes its certified welders with over 20 years of experience and a team that combines technical expertise with industry knowledge to deliver turnaround on both one-off and high-volume jobs. It states that it builds industrial-grade products even for non-industrial applications.
